intro: Across 19 articles spanning 13 April 2026 to 6 October 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of advanced persistent threats tracks GopherWhisper, CHOSEN BRICK, and CL-STA-1178. Government, energy, aviation, cryptocurrency, and financial services rank among the most affected sectors, while activity touches the United kingdom, United states, Global, Japan, and Middle east. Eighteen of the 19 reports carry a high severity rating. The archive below collects each report on these actors and the campaigns attributed to them.
